bio: Erin Leifer marched with the Crossmen (2003) and Phantom Regiment (2004, 2006, 2007) before becoming a color guard educator. She taught color guard at the Colts (2008-2009) and served as Lead Guard Instructor for Spirit of Atlanta (2010-2013), then joined Jersey Surf where she became Color Guard Caption Head. She also spent 11 seasons with Black Watch Winter Guard. She resides in Georgia, teaches sixth-grade mathematics, and directs the marching band and indoor color guard programs at Kell High School.

Hector Garcia serves as a Color Guard Instructor and Equipment Choreographer for Santa Clara Vanguard, where he has been a technician and choreographer since 2018. Born and raised in San Diego, California, he marched with Santa Clara Vanguard (2013-2014) and the Blue Devils (2015), with winterguard experience including Santa Clara Vanguard Winter Guard, Bluecoats Indoor, and Origins Winterguard. As an educator he has worked with several high schools, and he currently works full-time in healthcare at UCSD.

Jacob Daniel is a tuba/low brass instructor with over 13 years of teaching experience in the marching arts. He marched with Carolina Crown (2010, 2011, 2013) and Blue Devils B (2014), and has taught at Carolina Gold, River City Rhythm, Crossmen, and Santa Clara Vanguard, among other organizations. He earned a Bachelor's in Music Education from East Carolina University and a Master's in Tuba Performance from the University of Minnesota Twin Cities, and won a gold medal at the 2012 Leonard Falcone International Tuba and Euphonium Solo Competition.

Jason Raether is a registered nurse from Sioux Falls, South Dakota, and serves on the Santa Clara Vanguard medical staff. He has more than two decades of nursing experience spanning adult and pediatric critical care, rural hospital, emergency room, and nursing education, and currently works as a school nurse within the Sioux Falls School District. Beyond nursing, he works with marching bands across South Dakota and Iowa and with Groove, Inc. as a percussion technician and sound engineer.

Jazper Saldaña is a percussion educator who has served as Front Ensemble Caption Head for the Mandarins, Blue Stars, and Vigilantes Indoor Percussion, as well as being on staff with the Concord Blue Devils. Originally from San Diego, California, he earned a Bachelor's in Percussion Performance from California State University, Long Beach and a Master's in Percussion from the University of North Texas. He is the Percussion Band Director at Haltom High School in Fort Worth, TX.

Jeff Chambers is a composer and arranger who serves as brass arranger for the Seattle Cascades, co-brass arranger for the Hawthorne Caballeros, and co-music arranger for the Columbians Drum and Bugle Corps. Born in 1990 and raised in eastern Washington, he studied composition with Dan Bukvich and Robert Dickow at the University of Idaho. He has composed and arranged over 200 marching band shows and is recognized as a prominent marching arts designer.
